explication: FastApiAdmin is a full-stack enterprise administration platform with a Vue web client, a UniApp mobile client, and a FastAPI backend. Users authenticate, then use permission-aware system-management and monitoring features; optional modules add AI conversations, code generation, scheduled tasks, and multi-protocol storage workflows. The README also documents internal text chat, but the supplied tree does not show a distinct chat implementation, so it is not mapped as a runtime component. Edges reflect documented workflows and sampled controller behavior; unsampled wiring is left out.
